tools.name: scaffold_business_os
tools.description: Folder layout and starter files for a business operating system: the business CLAUDE.md questions and rules, the wiki layout (raw sources, topics, entities, index, log), plus STATE, CHANGELOG, TODO, INBOX and CLAUDE.md for each client and project named.

tools.name: house_rules
tools.description: The safety and memory rules block for a business CLAUDE.md: ask before sending, posting, spending or deleting; never invent facts; secrets only in .env; one home per fact; turn mistakes into rules.

tools.name: daily_routine
tools.description: How the memory works, the daily habit, the full text of the /pickup, /wrap, /biz-status, /biz-review, /trace, /ingest, /lint and /new-client command files, and how to use them with Codex or Grok.

tools.name: voice_guide_template
tools.description: How to build voice.md from two or three writing samples, plus the empty template.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "house_rules" references sensitive artifacts (.env, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
